top_news.title: Memory-Enforced GPU Sharing in Kubernetes with NVIDIA CUDA 13.4
top_news.dek: NVIDIA CUDA 13.4 introduces memory-enforced GPU sharing for Kubernetes environments.
top_news.brief: To improve GPU utilization, CUDA 13.4 adds memory boundaries to shared GPU workloads. This update addresses limitations in previous time-slicing methods by enforcing strict memory limits, allowing multiple processes to run concurrently with better isolation on shared hardware.

top_news.title: KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads
top_news.dek: KORA introduces a pre-inference control layer that prioritizes deterministic task paths over LLM calls to improve efficiency and verifiability.
top_news.brief: KORA addresses the inefficiency of invoking LLMs for structured or lookup-oriented tasks. By routing requests through deterministic paths first and only escalating to model inference when necessary, it reduces latency and cost while improving reliability. The system includes validation and telemetry for each route.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a request routing flow between deterministic paths and LLM inference

top_news.title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
top_news.dek: Security startup Cathedral used AI agents to exploit third-party software vulnerabilities and gain access to Anthropic's internal systems.
top_news.brief: As part of a bug bounty program, Cathedral researchers deployed AI agents to infiltrate Anthropic's internal sales, HR, and IT systems. The breach highlights the risks posed by external software dependencies, even for organizations focused on AI safety.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual illustration of AI agents navigating software security layers

top_news.title: Anthropic: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
top_news.dek: Anthropic is offering a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise and API access to all levels of U.S. government agencies.
top_news.brief: The expanded partnership with the GSA provides federal, state, local, and tribal governments with discounted access to Claude models. Anthropic is also launching a support program to assist agencies with implementation and integration of their AI tools.
top_news.image_alt: Anthropic and GSA partnership announcement graphic

primary.title: KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads
primary.summary: AI applications often invoke a model before they determine whether inference is necessary. That default is useful for ambiguous generative tasks, but it is poorly matched to work that is structured, deterministic, policy-bound, lookup-oriented, or directly verifiable.
